incidents.name: LI.FI
incidents.notes: LiFiDiamond: the GasZipFacet whose depositToGasZipERC20 performed an unvalidated arbitrary call was added by DiamondCut at 2024-07-16T10:03:23Z, about two hours (not five days) before the exploit; a further DiamondCut one minute later is the last change before the incident.

sources.ref: onchain review (RPC only): LiFiDiamond 0x1231DEB6f5749EF6cE6943a275A1D3E7486F4EaE created 2022-10-20T10:23:47Z at block 15788692; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded logs (topic 0xbc7cd75a...2d3b). Facets change via DiamondCut (topic 0x8faa70878671ccd212d20771b795c50af8fd3ff6cf27f4bde57e5d4de0aeb673) emitted by the diamond: 123 DiamondCut logs between creation and the incident block, all decoded into facet+action+selectors. The selector 0x3d86ea87 (depositToGasZipERC20((address,address,address,address,uint256,bytes,bool),uint256,address)) appears in exactly one cut in the entire history: the Add of GasZipFacet 0xf28a352377663ca134bd27b582b1a9a4dad7e534 with selectors 0x3d86ea87, 0x867372e4 (depositToGasZipNative), 0xba956b9a, 0xb78e6e40, 0x3c36bac1 at block 20318349, 2024-07-16T10:03:23Z, tx 0xee96ca692ef8f6bdff087e0669d11950e71302896f3af5320b2504540f5d4f26. The exploit tx is 0xd82fe84e63b1aa52e1ce540582ee0895ba4a71ec5e7a632a3faa1aff3e763873, block 20318963, 2024-07-16T12:06:35Z (DeFiHackLabs src/test/2024-07/Lifiprotocol_exp.sol), i.e. 2h03m after the facet was installed. One further cut sits between them and is the last change before the incident: block 20318354, 2024-07-16T10:04:23Z, tx 0x802aa23c9689750b69ac1b7fbe237be880b61666cc2d90a800f9de22a2b77154, Replace of selectors 0x2541ec57/0xad673d88 to facet 0x376f99f7eade8a17f036fcff9eba978e66e5fd28. The cut before that pair was 2024-07-02T16:37:35Z (block 20220066); there is no DiamondCut at all on this diamond between 2024-07-02 and 2024-07-16, so the previously recorded 2024-07-11 facet-addition date is not an Ethereum-mainnet change. Correction: 432000s (5.0d) -> 6937s (0.08d).
exploit tx backfilled and verified onchain (block 20318963; LiFiDiamond victim in receipt logs), matching the DeFiHackLabs PoC and BlockSec explorer

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2024-07-16T10:04:23Z (block 20318354, tx 0x802aa23c9689750b69ac1b7fbe237be880b61666cc2d90a800f9de22a2b77154): last DiamondCut on LiFiDiamond before the 2024-07-16T12:06:35Z exploit, a Replace of selectors 0x2541ec57/0xad673d88 to facet 0x376f99f7eade8a17f036fcff9eba978e66e5fd28; 60 seconds earlier, at 2024-07-16T10:03:23Z (block 20318349, tx 0xee96ca692ef8f6bdff087e0669d11950e71302896f3af5320b2504540f5d4f26), the same session Added the vulnerable GasZipFacet 0xf28a352377663ca134bd27b582b1a9a4dad7e534 (selector 0x3d86ea87 depositToGasZipERC20)
